status: Portable speed candidate ready. Four internal software-decode cases improved; AV1 effectively unchanged; decoded output matches exactly. Full-App CPU/RAM comparison with saved VLC has not been run, so the candidate is not adopted and an overall win is unproven.
method: One discarded process per variant/case, followed by rotated measured processes. Each process first hashes decoded output in a separate warmup, then initializes a fresh decoder and times fixed-count demux/decode/frame release. Open, stream discovery and codec initialization excluded. One decoder thread, warm file cache, no affinity change; raw process cycles and CPU time retained without converting to CPU utilization. Exact decoded buffers and frame metadata must match across both variants and all launches.
scope: CPU-only demux/software decode. No renderer, hardware decode, audio output or player windows. Not a whole-player benchmark.
profileChange: FFmpeg enable-small/-Os versus disable-small/-O3, and mpv/libplacebo size versus -O3 optimization. Same pinned source revisions, four maintained patches and GCC version; shader dependencies stay -Os without LTO. No fast-math, CPU target, scaling profile or decoder-feature reduction. The probe statically links the corresponding FFmpeg prefix and uses a different final LTO root set from the full libmpv DLL; its gains are not App CPU percentages.

nativeFunctional.scope: Hidden parent windows, null audio output; hardware/software AV1 and codec/control/filter/local-network cases. Physical WASAPI sink and visible cadence not validated.

appUnits.scope: Desktop PlaybackSession geometry deferred; not counted as passed.

pairedFrames.scope: Same direct filter settings both libraries; thirteen SDR cases exact. HDR fallback path/decoder verified and pixels reported, retaining adaptive peak-history limits.

stateful.scope: Crop/rotation, explicit FBO, software/hardware replacement, HDR/SDR return and stop/reopen in one hidden process. Saved control captures retain their original session.

validation.profileCacheGuard: Opposite profile rejected before compilation; native DLL, recipe ID and completed profile marker unchanged.
validation.timingGuard: Active compilation refused before creating benchmark output or launching a probe.
validation.package: Read-AperturePackage verified ten listed files; portable candidate prepared without launching/installing it.

tradeoffs.note: Candidate DLL is about 8.49 MiB larger. Full-player private RAM, startup and hardware-playback CPU effect remain unmeasured.

limits: Five measured processes per variant/case after one discarded process; every process also uses a separate decoded-output hash warmup before its fresh timed decoder. Warm local files, one software decoder thread, no affinity change.

Internal software demux/decode excludes player startup, rendering, hardware decoding, audio output, and file-open/codec initialization. It is not a player/VLC ranking or proof of the same speedup in libmpv.
H264/VP9/AAC run ranges separate in this batch; HEVC ranges overlap. AV1 changes about +0.2 percent in wall time and +0.09 percent in cycles, within overlapping ranges.
Exact hashes validate the tested decoded buffers/metadata. Hidden rendered checks do not establish physical presentation cadence.
Saved VLC evidence/dates/sessions unchanged. Any fresh full-player comparison requires a separately authorized visible Aperture-only test under the project rule.
dashboardFix: Resource-map point extraction now uses declared compatible history groups as the timeline does; the old per-protocol extraction was omitting compatible historical dots. Source readings are unchanged.
